What is B-Rewards?
B-Rewards is the BLOCH Loyalty program and is our way of showing you our appreciation. You’ll earn points for activities on and off our website, such as social likes and purchases. You can use them to earn discounts off purchases, so the more you collect the more you save.

Who can join?
Anyone with a BLOCH website account is automatically enrolled in the B-rewards loyalty program.

How do I earn points?
You can earn points for all sorts of activities including signing up for emails, liking BLOCH's social channels and making purchases. To see all the ways you can earn points click the Earn Points tab in the menu.

How do I view my point balance?
Your point balance is on every page in the top bar.

How do I redeem my points?
Select the tab called Redeem Points. Here you’ll see all the rewards we offer. If you have enough points, you can redeem them for a reward.

Is there a limit to the number of points I can earn?
No. Go ahead and earn as many as you can!

How long will my points be valid for?
All points will be valid for 12 months from the date they are added to your account

What do the 'approved', 'pending' and 'cancelled' statuses mean?
Approved: These points can be redeemed on rewards immediately
Pending: These points need to be verified before you can redeem them. All purchases will be pending for 30 days after purchase to account for any items you may want to return. You can only earn points on purchases you that aren't returned.
Cancelled: These points will not be added to your account. For example, this will happen if you cancel or return a purchase (the points will change from pending to cancelled)
Why did my account balance go down?
You may have cancelled or returned a purchase.

I completed an activity but didn't earn points!
It can sometimes take a few minutes for us to process your activity and provide your points.

Can I use my points during checkout?
Not directly - please redeem your points for a voucher which can then be applied during checkout.

How do I leave the program?
If you no longer wish to earn points, please contact us on uk@blochworld.com and ask to be unenrolled in the B-Rewards Loyalty Program. We'll unenroll you and you will lose any points you have accrued.

What happens if I leave and decide to join again?
Just contact us on us@blochworld.com and we'll re-enroll you. However, your point total will begin from zero.

Where can I report a problem or give feedback?
Please contact us on us@blochworld.com
